title: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who phases through matter and detects spirit energy, who tries to stop Jace from detonating the sylex.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker from Kamigawa who fights with shuriken and telekinesis and refuses to risk Kamigawa.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker, being compleated, who deceives Kaya with illusions and activates the sylex before Elspeth takes it from him.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker and warrior who defeats Ajani and then kills Jace and carries the activated sylex away.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker prince of Kaldheim whose Glimmervoid magic suppresses Tibalt, whom he kills.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker and Elspeth's former mentor, now compleated, who fights her with a double-headed axe.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A devil planeswalker, compleated, with twin barbed tails who spreads doubt and is killed by Tyvar.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler who welcomes the survivors to Phyrexia and starts the invasion.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A lithomancer planeswalker now compleated, her hands replaced by metal blades.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An animist planeswalker now compleated into a Phyrexian with root-like limbs.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker compleated and serving among Elesh Norn's warriors.

entities.name: Phyrexian Jace Beleren
entities.description: Jace's body, raised by Phyrexia after Elspeth kills him, which stands to join Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Jace's lost love, who is dead.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran fighter whose hope Kaya admires.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer who used the original sylex.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whose vision of the sylex's words passed through Kaya to Jace.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: Kaito's hexgold-gilded tanuki drone.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The compleated Phyrexian World Tree whose branches carry invasion ships through Omenpaths.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: A bomb whose carvings say to wipe the land clear, which Jace activates and Elspeth removes from the plane.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion ships
entities.description: White ships on the branches of Realmbreaker filling with Phyrexian warriors.

entities.name: Seedcore
entities.description: The core of New Phyrexia containing a miniature recreation of Elesh Norn's citadel and the root of the World Tree.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane that was Mirrodin.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Kaito's home plane filled with kami.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Tyvar's home plane.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane Elspeth thinks of as lost.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Pathways between planes along the branches of the World Tree used to carry the invasion.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, now reached by the World Tree.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: A great tree in Kamigawa that exists in harmony with spirits.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde launching its invasion of the Multiverse.

entities.name: The Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: Elesh Norn's invasion of the Multiverse, begun through the branches of the World Tree.

events.summary: Jace, Kaito and Kaya descend through the miniature citadel in the Seedcore, with Jace visibly being overtaken by wires.
events.quote: Jace didn't look good.

events.summary: Kaito and Kaya remark on the eerily sterile absence of spirits in Phyrexia.
events.quote: Phyrexia didn't release its victims, not even in death.

events.summary: Through a skylight they see the invasion ships filling with Phyrexian warriors.
events.quote: endless ranks of Phyrexian warriors in the red and white of Elesh Norn's faction filing into the increasingly gravid holds

events.summary: Kaito finds a hole leading to a disk near Realmbreaker's trunk, and they drop down to the point nearest the root.
events.quote: This was as close as they were going to come to the core root of the tree.

events.summary: Jace unpacks the sylex for the first time in Phyrexian air.
events.quote: He moved to unpack the sylex, revealing it to the Phyrexian air for the first time.

events.summary: Kaya urges Jace to wait, warning the blast could travel through the Omenpaths to every connected plane.
events.quote: We could blow up the Blind Eternities.

events.summary: Jace refuses to wait, saying Vraska is dead and he is dying and that the sylex must be detonated.
events.quote: Vraska is dead, and I am dying,

events.summary: Kaya grabs Jace's wrist and, with Kaito, draws a weapon against him to stop him.
events.quote: She pulled a dagger from her belt.

events.summary: On the bridge, Ajani urges Elspeth to join Phyrexia, then attacks her with his axe.
events.quote: You do not need to be alive to join Phyrexia.

events.summary: Tibalt taunts Tyvar as they fight with Tibalt's twin barbed tails.
events.quote: How does it feel to be the last prince of Kaldheim?

events.summary: Tibalt's doubt overwhelms Elspeth, who is disarmed by Ajani and backs away.
events.quote: Ajani's next blow knocked the weapon from her hands

events.summary: Kaya discovers that the Jace she attacked is an illusion and that two of three Jaces are fakes.
events.quote: two of the Jaces didn't have spirits.

events.summary: Kaito hits Jace's arm with shuriken, dispelling the false images; Kaya moves on the sylex.
events.quote: Producing a handful of shuriken from inside his shirt, he flung them at the true Jace

events.summary: Elspeth's will returns, she blocks Ajani's blow, and Tyvar's magic suppresses Tibalt and the doubt he spreads.
events.quote: Your doubt can't touch what it can't reach.

events.summary: Elspeth blasts Ajani back with white light and knocks him unconscious.
events.quote: driving him to the ground

events.summary: Tyvar kills Tibalt by driving his own tail barbs through his chest and throwing him from the bridge, as Elspeth runs to find the others.
events.quote: Tyvar driving the twin barbs of Tibalt's tail into the space that should have held the Phyrexian's heart.

events.summary: Kaya grabs what she thinks is the sylex, but it dissolves like mist because it was another of Jace's illusions.
events.quote: only for the sylex to dissolve in her hands like mist.

events.summary: Hidden by illusion, Jace pours his grief, Mirrodin's agony and his love for Vraska into the sylex and speaks the words to activate it.
events.quote: Wipe the land clear. Bring the ending,

events.summary: Elspeth drops through the ceiling and runs Jace through with her sword, taking the sylex.
events.quote: she drove her blade through Jace and shoved him aside

events.summary: Elspeth vanishes with the activated sylex, bound for a point beyond the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: The sylex went with her, bound for some unknown destination, some point beyond the Blind Eternities.

events.summary: Realmbreaker pulses and its branches wink out, carrying Phyrexian invaders through the Omenpaths to other planes.
events.quote: Each branch, with its heavy burden of Phyrexian invaders, had reached for another plane

events.summary: Elesh Norn enters with Phyrexian warriors, Tamiyo, and Jace's risen corpse, welcoming the survivors to Phyrexia.
events.quote: Welcome, weary travelers, to Phyrexia,

events.summary: Compleated Nahiri and Nissa are revealed beside Elesh Norn.
events.quote: Nahiri had clearly not survived her fall.

events.summary: The survivors refuse to yield, and Elesh Norn begins the invasion.
events.quote: and the invasion began.
